features.title: Shell output
features.detail: A background shell shows its command and live output. A cut line wraps in full, so nothing is lost at the edge. Show all opens the whole output, and Show less folds it back.

features.title: Timeline
features.detail: Switch the pane from Cards to Timeline to see every agent as a lane on one clock: when it started, how long it ran and whether it is still running. A click on a lane opens it like a click on its card.

features.title: The gates view
features.detail: A card per loop with one cell per gate: met, waiting on evidence (checked, but its evidence still reads pending), open or dropped. A click on the card groups its gates by state, with how long each open or waiting gate has been so. The band tip counts every gate in the session and the ones waiting. Gates come from `GATES.md` files written by your own script or tool, not from the model. The rest of the mod works without them.

features.title: GATES.md format
features.detail: This is the mod's own plan format; nothing else has to produce it. The ledger is `GATES.md` plus every `gates/<name>.md` in `~/.claude/gates/<repo>/<session id>/`, where `<repo>` is the folder name of the session's repo (or of its working folder). Set `GATES_HOME` to read `<GATES_HOME>/<repo>/<session id>/` instead. A gate is a line `- [ ] G1: what must hold`, with an indented `EVIDENCE:` line under it. It counts as met only when its box is `[x]` and its evidence is not `pending`. A line starting `ABANDON: G1 reason` gives that gate up. A `gates/<name>.md` file also belongs to the agent of that name.

features.title: Command hooks
features.detail: On SessionStart, Stop, SubagentStop and StopFailure, a small shell hook appends the event's JSON as one line to `~/.claude/mods-data/mod-progress/bridge/<session id>.jsonl` (under `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` when that is set), and the mod reads the file every 250 ms. A record can hold the session id, the working folder and the transcript path, and for Stop-type events the last assistant message. SessionEnd deletes the session's file, and SessionStart deletes files older than 7 days. The hooks need a POSIX shell (Git Bash on Windows). Without one they write nothing, and the mod falls back to what it can find on its own. Some plans block plugin hooks on these events; the mod then falls back the same way.
